actions.desc: Magically increases in size along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged it is Large doubles its damage dice on weapon attacks (included above) and makes Str checks and Str saves with advantage. While enlarged it also can no longer use the Summon Iceberg action. If it lacks the room to become Large this action fails.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Енларге»; тип: bonus_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Enlarge

traits.desc: Its weapons are imbued with icy magic. When it hits with any weapon deals + 4 (1d8) cold (included below). While enlarged it loses this bonus damage but AC increases to 16.

traits.desc: If it starts its turn enlarged it can choose to end the effect and return to its normal size (no action required).
